# GitHub Copilot Instructions for MWE Public Corpus

This repository is a GitHub-visible public surface for Meta-Writing Ecology.

It is not the full MWE archive, backend corpus, internal registry, complete methodology, or authority layer.

Follow these rules:

- Do not rewrite MWE concepts.
- Do not rename models, protocols, boundary notes, public anchors, or files unless explicitly instructed.
- Do not invent or promote relations between MWE concepts.
- Do not treat candidate or navigation relations as confirmed relations.
- Do not remove boundary statements.
- Do not change OSF priority.
- Do not edit MODEL_ATLAS, RELATION_MAP, READING_PATHS, or public anchors unless explicitly instructed.
- Do not treat public graph data as full ontology.
- Keep changes minimal and reversible.

Routine technical work is allowed when requested:
- link checks
- inventory generation
- JSON / CSV transformation
- script scaffolding
- mechanical repository maintenance

The user remains final authority for publication, naming, classification, relation confirmation, OSF registration, and merge decisions.
